Rare.name: Call of the Haunted
Rare.desc: Activate this card by targeting 1 monster in your GY; Special Summon that target in Attack Position. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster is destroyed, destroy this card.

Rare.name: Dangerous Machine Type-6
Rare.desc:
During each of your Standby Phases: Roll a six-sided die and apply the result.
● 1: Discard 1 card.
● 2: Your opponent discards 1 card.
● 3: Draw 1 card.
● 4: Your opponent draws 1 card.
● 5: Destroy 1 monster your opponent controls.
● 6: Destroy this card.

Rare.name: Elemental HERO Neos
Rare.desc: ''A new Elemental HERO has arrived from Neo-Space! When he initiates a Contact Fusion with a Neo-Spacian his unknown powers are unleashed.''

Rare.name: Enishi, Shien's Chancellor
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 2 "Six Samurai" monsters from your GY. Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster; destroy that target. This card cannot attack the turn this effect is activated.

Rare.name: Giant Germ
Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: Inflict 500 damage to your opponent, then you can Special Summon any number of "Giant Germs" from your Deck in face-up Attack Position.

Rare.name: Iron Blacksmith Kotetsu
Rare.desc: FLIP: Add 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to your hand.

Rare.name: Jinzo
Rare.desc: Trap Cards, and their effects on the field, cannot be activated. Negate all Trap effects on the field.

Rare.name: Junk Synchron
Rare.desc: When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 2 or lower monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position, but it has its effects negated.

Rare.name: Junk Warrior
Rare.desc:
"Junk Synchron" + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card is Synchro Summoned: It gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all Level 2 or lower monsters you currently control.

Rare.name: Light of Judgment
Rare.desc:
If "The Sanctuary in the Sky" is on the field: Discard 1 LIGHT monster to the GY; apply 1 of the following effects.
● Look at your opponent's hand and discard 1 card from their hand.
● Send 1 card your opponent controls to the GY.

Rare.name: Magic Cylinder
Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target the attacking monster; negate the attack, and if you do, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its ATK.

Rare.name: Magical Mallet
Rare.desc: Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into the Deck, then draw that same number of cards.

Rare.name: Messenger of Peace
Rare.desc: Monsters with 1500 or more ATK cannot declare an attack. Once per turn, during your Standby Phase, pay 100 LP or destroy this card.

Rare.name: Salvage
Rare.desc: Target 2 WATER monsters with 1500 or less ATK in your Graveyard; add those targets to your hand.

Rare.name: Super Solar Nutrient
Rare.desc: Activate this card by Tributing 1 Level 2 or lower Plant-Type monster; Special Summon 1 Plant-Type monster from your hand or Deck whose Level is less than or equal to the Level the Tributed monster had on the field +3. When this card leaves the field, destroy that monster. When that monster leaves the field, destroy this card.

Rare.name: Super Vehicroid - Stealth Union
Rare.desc:
"Truckroid" + "Expressroid" + "Drillroid" + "Stealthroid"
Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up non-Machine monster on the field; equip that target to this card. While equipped with a monster by this effect, this card can attack all monsters your opponent controls, once each. If this card attacks, its original ATK is halved. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

Rare.name: Thestalos the Firestorm Monarch
Rare.desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Discard 1 random card from your opponent's hand, then, if it was a Monster Card, inflict damage to your opponent equal to its original Level x 100.

Rare.name: UFO Turtle
Rare.desc: When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 FIRE monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, in face-up Attack Position.

Rare.name: Winged Kuriboh
Rare.desc: If this card on the field is destroyed and sent to the Graveyard: For the rest of this turn, you take no battle damage.
